title: Acyclicity of external tensor coefficients
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}(k)$ and $g:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}(k)$ scheme morphisms [def-pc-scheme], with $X,Y$ quasi-compact and with affine diagonals. Let $F,G$ be quasi-coherent modules [pqf-def-coherent] satisfying $H^p(X,F)=H^p(Y,G)=0$ for every $p>0$, where $H^p$ is module right-derived global sections [def-sc-ringed-space-module-cohomology]. For the actual external tensor coefficients $E=\operatorname{pr}_1^*F\otimes\operatorname{pr}_2^*G$ [def-sc-field-linear-module-cohomology-operations], one has $H^n(X\times_kY,E)=0$ for every natural $n>0$. This does not assert anything about a cochain comparison map or its normalization.

source.place: Tag 0BED, lemma-kunneth, equation-kunneth-on-cech and acyclic Leray base case; final degree-zero cup verification

proof.text: Apply lem-sc-picard-external-coefficients-direct-images to F and G using hF. It gives zero positive higher direct images of the external coefficients under pr2 and a coproduct cofan of copies of G for R^0 pr2_* E. No condition on the cohomology of G enters this calculation.

Use Mathlib's IsAffineHom-to-QuasiCompact instance on the diagonal of g to construct QuasiSeparated g, then quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated g since Spec k is affine. For p>0, apply the qcqs direct-sum cohomology bijection to the coproduct cofan. Each H^p(Y,G) is zero by hG, so its algebraic direct sum is subsingleton and surjectivity gives zero H^p(Y,R^0 pr2_* E). For q>0 the additive module-cohomology functor preserves zero objects, so H^p(Y,R^q pr2_* E) is zero as well.

The vanishing of every positive-degree column makes the existing Leray edge an isomorphism on E. At n>0, R^n pr2_* E is zero, hence so are its global sections and their underlying additive group. Transport this across the additive edge isomorphism. The forgetful functor does not change underlying elements, so subsingleton of the additive group implies the module cohomology object is zero.

lean.statement: theorem picardExternalCupCoefficients_acyclic (k : Type w) [Field k] (X Y : Scheme.{w}) (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) [CompactSpace X] [CompactSpace Y] [IsAffineHom (pullback.diagonal f)] [IsAffineHom (pullback.diagonal g)] (F : X.Modules) (G : Y.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] [G.IsQuasicoherent] (hF : ∀ p : ℕ, 0 < p → IsZero ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace p).obj F)) (hG : ∀ p : ℕ, 0 < p → IsZero ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology Y.toRingedSpace p).obj G)) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : IsZero ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology (Limits.pullback f g).toRingedSpace n).obj (externalCupCoefficients f g F G))
